_about: The one source of the installation and feature status shown by the site and the documentation. The extras table is pyproject.toml's [project.optional-dependencies] (packages and versions) with the purpose written here: web/scripts/gen-data.mjs and docs/site/generate.py fail if an extra of pyproject.toml has no purpose here (a purpose of an extra that a tree does not ship is not shown). 'features' is the release status of each part, shown on the Install page and in the documentation (install and GPU pages).

extras.tutorials: The figures and labelled arrays of the tutorials.
extras.gpu: Device arrays for the CUDA backend (the CUDA wheel, or a source build with CONATUS_CUDA=ON).
extras.mpi: The distributed solver over several processes.
extras.notebook: Widgets for explain() and parameters in Jupyter.
extras.studio: The Studio server: watch and control runs from a browser.
extras.dedalus-compare: Dedalus 3, needed only by the optional check script of tutorial 14.

features.note: The 0.2 wheels are for Linux x86-64. On Windows, install Conatus inside WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux). macOS, Windows and Linux aarch64 wheels are planned for 1.0.
The configuration the test suite runs for each release.
Double precision. Not retested on GPU hardware for the current release.

features.feature: Fused nonlinear kernels on the GPU
features.note: Box and channel: compiled fused kernels. Sphere, ball and shell: a right-hand side planned once, with generated product kernels. Disk, annulus and cylinder: not fused.
doctor reports mpi4py if it is installed; the public release runs in one process.
pip install "conatus[studio]", then python -m conatus.studio.hub serve --local: the hub module, with a relay in the same process, on 127.0.0.1.

features.feature: Studio hosted hub and remote relays
features.note: The hub and relay modules ship because the local server uses them. Serving the hub outside 127.0.0.1, or running a relay that connects to a remote hub, was not tested for this release, and the deployment files are not included. Planned.
